name: list_employees
description: This tool belongs to the OrgChartAPI, which exposes read-only access to employees and their historical reporting relationships. Tool description: Return all employees in the company org chart dataset.

name: get_reporting_history
description: This tool belongs to the OrgChartAPI, which exposes read-only access to employees and their historical reporting relationships. Tool description: Return all historical reporting relationships where the given employee was the direct report (subordinate). Each row is one reporting period.

employee_id.description: The employee id of the subordinate.

reporting_history.description: Historical reporting rows for this employee.

manager_id.description: Manager employee id for this period.

manager_name.description: Manager display name for this period.
